name: Canvas Menagerie
source:
Niko is a lifelong actor who’s been bouncing from audition to audition, unable to score more than a commercial here and there, until he suddenly gets the lead role in a major teen drama. There he meets a variety of other actors from all walks of life and starts to fall for his costar Ren, one of the biggest movie celebrities right now, who happens to play his rival in the show.

Canvas Menagerie is wholesome slice of life visual novel that follows Niko and his fellow castmates—and crush, celebrity costar Ren—going through their 20s together in the Hollywood of the South—Atlanta, Georgia.

[From [url=https://crystalgameworks.itch.io/canvas-menagerie]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
尼科是一名终生演员，他一直在试镜中跳来跳去，除了到处拍广告外，他只能取得更多的成绩，直到他突然在一部主要的青少年戏剧中担任主角。在那里，他遇到了来自各行各业的其他演员，并开始爱上他的搭档任，目前最知名的电影名人之一，他恰好在剧中扮演他的对手。

《Canvas Menagerie》是一部健康生活的视觉小说，讲述了尼科和他的剧组伙伴——以及暗恋的名人搭档任——在南方好莱坞——佐治亚州亚特兰大一起度过了20多岁的故事。

[来自[url=https://crystalgameworks.itch.io/canvas-menagerie]itch.io[/url]]
